title: Grayskull: A tiny computer vision library in C for embedded systems, etc.
description: Grayskull is a new open-source computer vision library tailored for resource-constrained devices like microcontrollers, drones, and robotics, developed in C with a focus on minimalism and efficiency. This lightweight library offers key features such as image manipulation, filtering, morphological operations, and object tracking, making it a valuable tool for developers in the embedded systems domain. With its user-friendly design, Grayskull enables complex image processing tasks with minimal code, fostering innovation in technology.
